faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MRVC Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 27th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for the Project Engineer (Signal & Telecom) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A four-year Bachelor's Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering or M.Sc Electronics with at least 70% marks is required.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience in S&T projects is mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST and OBC/NCL categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 140,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for MRVC recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on Document Verification, Interaction/Interview, and merit determined by performance, qualification, and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for MRVC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, or by visiting the official website of MRVC.
